async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				await operation(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
}
class WrongBody {
	async mapLimit(items, operation) {
		for (const item of items) {
			// ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
			await operation(item);
		}
	}
}
